tasks.short: Order supplies and inspect incoming deliveries

steps.what: Check supplies, planned batches and equipment needs
Prepare supplier order with quantities, pack sizes and prices
Check order totals and send approved supplier order
Receive supplies, check condition and resolve delivery discrepancies

tasks.design: Configure saved supplier items and pack conversions in {PROCUREMENT}. The baker still measures need, enters quantities, checks the exact order before sending and inspects the delivery.
tasks.previous_blocker: Repeated catalogue navigation and order entry.
tasks.enabler_now: Existing purchasing forms can retain regular items and validate units.
tasks.still_hard: Freshness, substitutions and equipment suitability need inspection and judgement.
tasks.human_edge: Recognise a delivery that is technically complete but unsuitable for the next bake.
tasks.altitude: A little less order entry; purchasing authority stays the same.

reach.task: Agree supply cover for a changed bake plan
reach.learn: Lead times and usable stock rather than nominal stock

evidence.claim: Saved order items and pack conversions are a plausible native purchasing configuration; this saving is an unmeasured scenario.

assumptions: Boundary is the baker's ordering and receiving work, excluding supplier fulfilment and payment.

Baker produces purchase needs in s1 and captures item, required quantity, unit, delivery date and supplier in s2; capture remains within its 50% time. Supplier catalogue supplies item codes, pack quantities and current prices under the existing supplier contract. Missing values are entered and checked manually in s2.
Test native configuration before custom code. No saving is attributed to existing system runtime.
Physical receipt and order approval retain all their baseline time. Inventory-record posting is a separate task and must not be added twice.
research_questions: Does saved-item entry reduce s2 time after quantity capture and pack checks?

incremental.description: Maintain saved items and changed pack sizes

approvals.approved_version: Exact supplier, item, quantity, unit, price and delivery date displayed immediately before send; any change requires another check

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=90; gross 10 minus upkeep 2 gives net 8. High assumes regular catalogue orders; low assumes exceptions consume the entry gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Maintain inventory and batch production records

steps.what: Count inventory and capture batch output, usage and waste
Enter tally into inventory and production records
Reconcile production records against stock and investigate mismatches

tasks.design: Capture the existing tally directly in a native {OPS_SYSTEM} batch form, retaining the counting and observation time. Reuse those entries in the inventory and production ledger; the baker checks failed entries and investigates physical discrepancies.
tasks.previous_blocker: Paper observations were keyed again into the ledger.
tasks.enabler_now: A batch form can reuse entered fields without a second transcription.
tasks.still_hard: Actual waste, unrecorded usage and mixed lots require physical investigation.
tasks.human_edge: Explain why a stock difference occurred before correcting a food record.
tasks.altitude: Less transcription; batch accountability stays with the baker.

reach.learn: Consistent units and reasons without treating missing entries as zero

evidence.claim: Aptean Bakery ERP maintains formulas, allergen information and product costs; that supports a bakery records setting, not a measured saving for tally capture.
Direct batch entry can remove repeat transcription when native ledger fields align.

assumptions: Boundary starts with physical inventory and batch observations and ends with reconciled records; supplier receipt inspection is outside this task.

Baker produces batch ID, ingredient or product ID, lot, quantity, unit, movement type, date and observed waste in s1. Its full 55% remains for observation and form capture. Missing or ambiguous fields use a retained paper tally and manual entry in s2, never inferred consumption.
Test native batch forms before a custom integration. No existing machine runtime is counted as labour saved.
Counts and investigations keep their time. Resolve ownership of receipt and production capture before adding this to another role's workflow.
unknowns: Native batch and unit validation support
research_questions: Can one batch entry populate the ledger without losing lot or waste detail?

already_counted.description: Failed-entry checks and manual tally exceptions

incremental.description: Maintain item mappings and review form failures

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=80; gross 20 minus upkeep 3 gives net 17. High requires duplicate entry today; low assumes paper exceptions absorb most gains.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Coordinate bakery deliveries and resolve changes

steps.what: Confirm bakery deliveries, readiness, addresses and customer time windows
Compile delivery list and proposed sequence
Direct drivers and negotiate delivery changes or shortages

tasks.design: Use a native {OPS_SYSTEM} delivery-list view to prepare the proposal from confirmed facts. The baker retains readiness checks, route judgement and every driver or customer conversation; no route is automatically dispatched.
tasks.previous_blocker: Confirmed delivery details were recopied into a separate list.
tasks.enabler_now: A saved native view can assemble order fields for review.
tasks.still_hard: Readiness and late changes cannot be inferred from an order's original promise.
tasks.human_edge: Choose a workable response to a late bake without promising an impossible delivery.
tasks.altitude: A shorter preparation step with unchanged dispatch responsibility.

reach.task: Align bake completion with dispatch commitments
reach.learn: Vehicle constraints and customer time windows

evidence.claim: A native order view can reuse confirmed delivery fields in a list; route decisions remain human in this scenario.

assumptions: Boundary covers baker coordination, excluding driving, loading and customer receipt.

In s1 the baker confirms and captures order ID, structured address, customer window, quantity, ready time and available driver. Full s1 time remains. Existing customer order capture is unchanged; corrections are verified by phone in s1. Unknown fields force manual preparation in s2.
Native saved views are tested before custom route software. Sequence review stays in s2 and final coordination in s3; existing runtime earns no saving.
unknowns: Address quality and last-minute change volume
research_questions: Does the native list reduce preparation after readiness and address checks?

already_counted.description: Review delivery list and handle incomplete fields

incremental.description: Maintain list fields and dispatch-view exceptions

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=90; gross 10 less upkeep 2 gives net 8. High assumes repeat list preparation; low assumes changing deliveries consume that gain.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Define baked goods brief and collect ingredient specifications
Develop candidate recipes and select plausible trial variants

loop.purpose: Suggest a few recipe variants meeting a specific brief
loop.input: Recipe brief, checked ingredient table and existing recipes
loop.output: Up to three draft trial recipes with ingredient references and rationale
loop.check: Baker checks flavour intent, feasible process and every ingredient against the brief; unsupported substitutions are rejected
loop.stop: One draft and one revision, then manual recipe development if unsuitable
loop.why_not_simpler: A fixed template can scale an existing recipe but cannot propose a different flavour concept

steps.what: Calculate recipe percentages, ingredient costs and allergen worksheet
Bake trial recipes, taste results and adjust process
Finalise tested recipe and check cost and allergen specification

tasks.design: Use a bounded draft step in {DOCS} for recipe ideas, then native {ERP} formula features or a checked {SPREADSHEET} for percentages and cost. Ingredient specifications supply allergen data; the baker retains trial baking, sensory judgement and the final specification check.
tasks.previous_blocker: Idea drafting and recipe arithmetic required separate manual work.
tasks.enabler_now: Bounded drafting can propose variants while existing formula tools handle arithmetic.
tasks.still_hard: A plausible recipe may bake poorly, and ingredient omissions can make allergen information unsafe.
tasks.human_edge: Judge texture, handling and flavour from an actual bake.
tasks.altitude: Less drafting and arithmetic without adding trial capacity or changing release authority.

reach.task: Assess whether a successful trial can run at production scale
reach.learn: Yield loss, mixing capacity and repeatability

evidence.claim: Tastewise supports trend-led flavour concepts and recipe ideation.
Aptean Bakery ERP maintains formulas, allergens and product costs.
The allocation and savings are an unmeasured recipe-development scenario, not transferred sales or trial results.

assumptions: Boundary includes recipe development and final specification, excluding routine production and public label release.

Baker produces the brief and checked ingredient table in s1, recording ingredient ID, supplier specification version, unit, price and declared allergens. Full capture time remains. Baker reviews variant ingredient quantities in s2 before s3; unresolved or missing specifications stop calculation and require manual checking, never model-inferred allergens.
Native formula and costing configuration is tested first. Model output supplies ideas only; no autonomous substitution or release.
All trial baking and final checks retain baseline time. Each post-trial ingredient change requires recalculation and review in s5.
unknowns: Time currently spent ideating versus baking
research_questions: Do useful draft variants reduce ideation time after rejecting unsuitable recipes?

already_counted.description: Check recipe meaning, substitutions and process feasibility
Check calculated quantities, costs and allergen inputs

incremental.description: Maintain drafting constraints and formula checks

approvals.approved_version: Exact tested ingredient quantities, process, supplier-specification versions, cost and allergen worksheet; any change voids approval

time_saved_range_pct.basis: B=100 R=84; gross 16 minus upkeep 3 gives net 13. High assumes useful ideas and reliable specification inputs; low assumes rejected drafts and corrections consume gains. Trials retain all 45 hours.

role.altitude: The baker keeps physical production and food decisions, with less repeated entry and drafting.
reach: Help a production supervisor assess recipe repeatability and delivery constraints
role.ambitious_version: Develop tested products with clearer records while retaining practical baking judgement.
